Game Overview

In Fishing Clicker, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an intense fishing journey with Mr. D, trapped in a time loop. In Fishing Clicker, your clicks determine his fate. Dive into a colorful narrative, fish through stunning landscapes, and unlock new areas. The thrill of progression leads to an epic conclusion.
